question: Which of the following cell types produces testosterone?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Leydig cells -> produce testosterone -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: Sertoli cells -> support sperm development -> do not produce testosterone -> 90% confidence. CHAIN: Myoid cells -> provide structural support in the seminiferous tubules -> do not produce testosterone -> 85% confidence. CHAIN: Spermatogonias -> are the germ cells that give rise to sperm -> do not produce testosterone -> 95%
analysis: Testosterone is primarily produced by Leydig cells in the testes.
